question: What immediate power over the three worlds results from this contemplation?
premises: The practitioner contemplates the deity as described.
The contemplation is addressed to Parameśānī.
The result is enchanting the three worlds instantly.
inference: Contemplating the deity in this form grants the power to enchant the three worlds in an instant.
plain_english: O supreme goddess, by contemplating her thus one can enchant the three worlds in an instant.
